messages:
Mira: Quick proposal: introduce an "Anchor Set" for the catalog - a tiny curated set of models we promise stability for. Goal: reduce churn surface for customers and simplify onboarding criteria. Sketch: Anchor = 3 models per workload family, each with clear bench, pin policy, and migration runway. Thoughts?

Ben: +1. Important to define bench minima per workload: latency p95, top-1 quality pass on smoke evals, embedding-shape invariant. Can we formalize thresholds per family?

Sofia: Yes. Draft minima: text-gen: p95 <= 240ms, qa_pass >= 0.9; embeddings: shape-stable = true, cosine-delta <= 0.05; cost_delta <= +25% vs baseline. I'll add specifics to the doc.

Eli: Pin policy idea: Anchor models get 120d default pin TTL with auto-notices at 60/30/10 days. Non-anchor default = 45d. Enterprise pin extensions via SOW + a verification run. Why 120d? gives customers predictable window without stagnation.

Mira: Interesting — 120d longer than usual but acceptable for anchors. We should allow a "soft-extend" for active migrations: automatically extend pins by 30d if migration-cli reports >5% failing prompts.

Ben: Runtime constraints: must support dual-serve mode for pinned tenants (old+new) behind a feature flag. Dual-serve should be rate-limited and expire after the migration runway. Any dual-serve increases cost; must be gated to paid extensions after the free window.

Sofia: Agree. Also require embed-contract on entries: a manifest that declares output shape and field names. If manifest changes, block auto-migrate and require explicit opt-in.

comm-bot: Created ticket CATALOG-914: "anchor-set spec + embed contract schema" assigned to sofia.

Eli: Soft-rollout pattern proposal for anchor upgrades: 5% x 7d, 25% x 5d, 50% x 2d, collect latency/eval/error signals. Automatic rollback on any signal breach. Exec override required to skip rollout.

Mira: Owners: Mira (product) finalize anchor spec + comms, Ben (eng-runtime) dual-serve + rollout controller, Sofia (eval) bench harness + manifest schema, Eli (CS/sales) SOW skeleton & migration pricing. Meeting Wed 4pm to lock in.

Ben: I'll prototype the dual-serve flag this week and post a PR link.

Sofia: I'll attach example manifests and a small canary dataset by Tue.

Mira: If no objections I'll merge Monday and schedule a Q3 initiative slot. Thanks all.
